page:activities: KWIKAR lists tours, attraction tickets and experiences across the UAE, with Dubai and Abu Dhabi at the centre. You can browse by category, such as theme parks, desert adventures, cruises and city tours, or by destination, then open any experience to compare its options and current supplier prices. Every booking starts with a request on WhatsApp: our team checks availability for your date and group, confirms the final AED price and terms, and only then asks for payment. Prices shown come from live supplier rates and are refreshed several times a day.
page:destinations: Choose a city first, then pick what to do there. Dubai has the widest choice, from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Frame to desert safaris and dhow cruises. Abu Dhabi is home to Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World, Yas Waterworld and Louvre Abu Dhabi. Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah add mountains, beaches and quieter desert trips, and a few experiences outside the UAE, such as a Musandam day trip in Oman, are listed too. Each destination page shows every experience we currently offer there, with prices from live supplier rates.
dest:dubai: Dubai packs record-breaking landmarks, desert dunes and beaches into one city, so most visitors mix all three. Start with the view from Burj Khalifa or Dubai Frame, then add an evening in the desert with dinner at a camp, or a dhow cruise through Dubai Marina. Families have theme parks and water parks such as Aquaventure, plus Ski Dubai and the aquarium for hot afternoons. From October to May, seasonal favourites such as Global Village and Dubai Miracle Garden are open. Book outdoor activities for the morning or evening in summer.
dest:abu-dhabi: Abu Dhabi, the UAE's capital, is about 90 minutes' drive from Dubai and works as a day trip or a stay of its own. Yas Island has three big theme parks close together: Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World and Yas Waterworld. Saadiyat Island is the culture district, with Louvre Abu Dhabi. Qasr Al Watan, the presidential palace, and the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque show the city's heritage; dress modestly for both. A private transfer from Dubai or a city tour with pickup is the easiest way to fit several sights into one day.
dest:other: These experiences take place outside the main city centres or run across more than one emirate, so they are grouped here rather than under a single city. They include desert retreats and heritage safaris, such as the vintage G-Class drive at Al Marmoom, overnight camps, conservation drives, water parks and dinner cruises. Most include hotel pickup from Dubai; check each experience for the pickup area and timings. If you are not sure which one suits your plans, send us your dates on WhatsApp and our team will suggest the best fit.
dest:ras-al-khaimah: Ras Al Khaimah, the northernmost emirate, is about an hour's drive from Dubai and is known for mountains, red dunes and quieter beaches. Experiences here include a city tour of the old town and museum, a desert safari with dinner, and buggy and ATV rides in the dunes. A shared transfer to Dubai Mall is also available for visitors staying in Ras Al Khaimah. Because the emirate is less crowded than Dubai, it suits travellers who want a slower pace or a short break from the city.
dest:fujairah: Fujairah sits on the UAE's east coast, facing the Gulf of Oman, with the Hajar Mountains behind it. It is a good base for snorkelling, diving and beach time, and for seeing older sights such as Al Bidya Mosque and Fujairah Fort. The private Fujairah city tour starts from Fujairah itself, so it suits guests already staying on the east coast. From Dubai, allow around two hours each way by road; ask us about a private transfer if you want to combine the coast with a day of sightseeing.
dest:oman: The Musandam Peninsula belongs to Oman but sits at the northern tip of the UAE, so it is reachable as a day trip from Dubai. Its fjord-like inlets, known as khors, are best seen by dhow, with stops for swimming and snorkelling in clear water. You cross a land border on the way, so bring your passport and check the entry rules for your nationality before you book. Our team confirms pickup times, border requirements and what is included in your trip.
cat:city-tours: A city tour is the quickest way to see a lot in one day, with a guide and transport arranged for you. Dubai tours usually combine old Dubai, the creek and souks with modern landmarks; Abu Dhabi tours focus on the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Qasr Al Watan and the Corniche. Many include hotel pickup, and some can be booked privately for your group. Check the duration and stops of each tour, and remember modest dress for mosques and palaces.
cat:theme-parks: The UAE has some of the region's biggest theme parks, mostly in Dubai and on Yas Island in Abu Dhabi. Ferrari World is known for its record-breaking roller coasters, Warner Bros. World has indoor themed lands, and Dubai has options from Global Village to IMG Worlds. Most parks are indoors or partly shaded, which makes them good for hot days. Compare single-park tickets with combos, check height rules for rides, and send us your date and ages so we can confirm the right ticket.
cat:desert-adventures: A desert trip is one of the most popular things to do in the UAE. The classic evening safari includes dune bashing in a 4x4, a sunset stop and dinner with live shows at a desert camp; other options include morning safaris, quad bikes and buggies, vintage G-Class drives, and overnight camps. Hotel pickup is included on most trips. Dune bashing is not suitable for pregnant women or guests with back problems; ask us for a gentler option.
cat:water-activities: Water activities in the UAE range from water parks such as Aquaventure and Yas Waterworld to time on the sea itself. You can ride a jet ski or flyboard near Burj Al Arab, take a speed boat past the Dubai skyline, or join a yacht or dhow cruise. Most sea activities need a minimum age and a short safety briefing, and timings depend on the weather. From May to September, mornings and late afternoons are the most comfortable time to be on the water.
cat:cultural-experiences: These experiences show the UAE's history, art and heritage. Visit Louvre Abu Dhabi and Qasr Al Watan, explore museums in Dubai, or join a heritage drive in the desert. Many cultural sites ask visitors to dress modestly, with shoulders and knees covered, and some close one day a week or for prayers. Opening hours change during Ramadan and public holidays, so our team confirms the timings for your date when you send a request.
cat:family-activities: Family activities in the UAE cover all ages, from aquariums and zoos to theme parks and water parks. Indoor options such as Ski Dubai and the aquarium suit midday in summer, while parks and outdoor attractions are best in the cooler months. Most experiences have child prices, and some let younger children in free; height and age rules apply to many rides. Tell us your children's ages when you send a request so we can confirm the right tickets.
cat:luxury-experiences: Luxury experiences on KWIKAR include private yacht cruises, premium desert camps, vintage car safaris and upgraded tickets with lounges or fast-track entry. These suit special occasions, couples and small groups who want more space and personal service. Many can be booked privately and adjusted to your timings. Send us your date, group size and the kind of experience you want, and our team will suggest options and confirm the final price before you pay.
cat:attraction-tickets: Attraction tickets let you visit at your own pace without a guided tour. On KWIKAR you can book entry to observation decks, aquariums, parks and museums across the UAE. Many tickets have timed entry or peak and off-peak prices, so the slot you choose can change the price. Send your preferred date and number of guests; our team confirms availability and the final price, then sends your tickets after payment.
cat:cruises: A cruise is one of the most relaxed ways to see Dubai's skyline. Choose a traditional wooden dhow with a buffet dinner in Dubai Marina, a dinner cruise on Dubai Creek or the Water Canal, or a larger dinner cruise ship with live entertainment. Most evening cruises last about two hours and include dinner and soft drinks; hotel transfers are optional on many. Smart casual dress works on every cruise, and a light layer helps in winter on open decks.
cat:yachts: Yacht trips in Dubai come in two styles: shared tours, where you book seats on a yacht with other guests, and private charters for your own group. Shared tours are the easier way to try a yacht, with set times for sunset or dinner and food on board. Most yachts sail from Dubai Marina or Dubai Harbour and cruise past JBR, Ain Dubai and the Palm. Bring ID, arrive early for boarding, and check what each trip includes before you book.
cat:events: Events in the UAE include concerts, shows, festivals and seasonal celebrations such as New Year's Eve. Ticket types, age limits and entry rules are set by each organiser and can change close to the date. Send us the event and your preferred seats, and our team checks availability and confirms the final price before you pay.
